content: राधा .²1 Prosperity, success. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated Gopī or cowherdess loved by Kṛṣṇa (whose amours have been immortalized by Jayadeva in his Gītagovinda); तदिमं राधे गृहं प्रापय <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the wife of Adhiratha and foster-mother of Karṇa. .²4 The lunar mansion called विशाखा. .²5 Lightning. .²6 An attitude in shooting. .²7 Emblic Myrobalan. .²8 The full-moon day in the month of Vaiśākha. .²9 Devotedness. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (Clytoria Ternatea; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>विष्णुक्रान्ता</ns>).
